prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was bouncing between cities a lot—one weekend in Nanjing I ended up at a clinic there, and later that month I also caught a game while I was in Shanghai.
I remember after that visit I stopped by a pharmacy and picked up the medicine the doctor mentioned—nothing dramatic, just the usual stuff.
Funny detail: my friend had already set up an appointment for Deng Hui with Dr. Fang Ming, in the morning on 2025-05-06, so everything was already taken care of.
